Dow - a question

The ‘official’ ABCs for this tune have the key as Gdorian but the key signature is that of Gmajor - an F# rather than the Bb that I’d expect. What is the proper key signature, or really, are the Fs natural and the B flatted in this tune?

↳ Posted by Martin_BC on July 25th, 2009.

It’s Gdor - go by the ABCs. I think the sheetmusic was a mistake that was edited later by the submitter.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on February 21st, 2011.

This tune is in G minor, I learned it from Tommy one time and it was definitely G minor

↳ Posted by suzyfiddle on October 22nd, 2011.

It has E naturals. It’s G dorian.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on January 26th, 2013.
